summary: I re-measured W5b's own art and it holds. Face chips: every pair is >= 55 at 26 px (min 59.5, 0 of 120 pairs under 55, Ilsheta included). Odrum Shadeprint's mask saturation is 0.61 (gate 0.25) with lit amber slits. Rishal's head and accent are fixed (rear vanes off, accent 2.28 %, all of it on the head, for the base and both skins). Burdam has his flat roundel pauldron plate, and my own Blender audit gives cast_ult f3/f4 torso 0/0. Hesmi's attacks have a 5-frame hold and a 2-frame strike of 2.1 m (attack1) and 1.8 m (attack2). The plates in the client's own windows read p50 76-102 (loading window, art only) and 71-106 (draft cell), and the figures stand at 0.706-0.764 of the card. The wave still fails on two counts. First, done:5 fails in the client: luma.cjs on my fresh 1920 loading shot reads card p50 34-47 and plate box 44-60. W5b's own emulator shows the CSS it handed to W2 would still leave cards at p50 51-75 (median 62), so neither lane's plan closes the gate yet. Second, HUD-2 is honestly partly done: only the minimap draws the chips, and Portrait.tsx:59 still loads portrait.png. Minor regressions: Burdam's new plate adds cleaver-in-body frames in victory (torso 100 -> 117), dash (12 -> 25) and idle_lobby (9 -> 12). I looked at every new image (16 chips, 48 portraits, 48 splashes, the Rishal, Odrum, Burdam and Lisvel close-ups) and found no blocker. Two minor watch items: Dunsom's beaked mask is now the whole chip (the bill change is ruled but still pending), and Sukri's hollow-eyed mask has grain streaks running down from the eyes.
